name: Validate Part 1 Docs Structure

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

jobs:
  validate-docs:
    name: Check /docs folder and required files
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Verify /docs folder exists
        run: |
          if [ ! -d "docs" ]; then
            echo "The /docs folder is missing."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "docs folder exists"

      - name: Verify required files are present
        run: |
          REQUIRED_FILES=(
            "docs/RaceDay_ERD.png"
            "docs/RaceDay_Schema.sql"
            "docs/API_Endpoint_Plan.md"
          )

          MISSING=0
          for file in "${REQUIRED_FILES[@]}"; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              echo "Found: $file"
            else
              echo "MISSING: $file"
              MISSING=1
            fi
          done

          if [ $MISSING -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "One or more required files are missing."
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "All required files are present"

      - name: Summary
        run: |
          echo "Part 1 Documentation Validation PASSED"
